snippet.title: My Dear Emma - gamescom Announcement Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
My Dear Emma is a quiet first-person narrative adventure about grief, memory, and saying goodbye.

You play as Emma Wiedman, a 34-year-old biologist and nature photographer who returns to her grandparents’ estate after the death of her grandfather. Waiting for her is one final scavenger hunt he prepared: ten personal puzzles leading across the estate and its surroundings.

As Emma explores, she gradually reconstructs the story of her grandfather’s final years through notes, objects, places, and memories. The world itself does not change. Instead, Emma’s perception of familiar places evolves, revealing details and connections that were always there.

The ten puzzles also reflect her grandfather’s progressing dementia. What begins with clear and carefully documented clues gradually becomes incomplete, contradictory, repetitive, and increasingly difficult to read. The puzzles themselves do not become more complex – the traces left by his dementia make them harder to solve.

Through free exploration, environmental storytelling, and fragmented memories, Emma tries to understand the final years she was not there for – and ultimately come to terms with her grandfather’s goodbye.

Wishlist My Dear Emma now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2577080/My_Dear_Emma/
